name: Max Horkheimer
shortBio: Director of the Frankfurt Institute for Social Research and architect of Critical Theory. Co-authored Dialectic of Enlightenment with Adorno, diagnosing how instrumental reason converts enlightenment into domination.
centralQuestion: How can reason liberate humanity from suffering rather than becoming a technical tool for totalitarian control and domination over nature?

keyWorks.title: Dialectic of Enlightenment
keyWorks.description: Foundational text of Critical Theory diagnosing how the project of enlightenment inverted into myth, mass culture, and bureaucratic barbarism.

keyWorks.title: Eclipse of Reason
keyWorks.description: Critique of the historical transformation from objective reason to subjective instrumental reason concerned with means and operational efficiency.

keyWorks.title: Traditional and Critical Theory
keyWorks.description: Seminal essay demarcating positivistic, passive 'traditional theory' from emancipatory, reflective 'critical theory' oriented toward human freedom.
